paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of NiTi-Based Eutectic Shape Memory Alloy Produced via Selective Laser Melting In-Situ Alloying by Nb

evidence.quote: This paper presents the results of selective laser melting (SLM) process of a nitinol-based NiTiNb shape memory alloy.
- NiTiNb shape memory alloy can be produced by SLM in-situ alloying by Nb with a relative density of 99%.
The eutectic alloy Ni 45Ti45Nb10 with a shape memory effect was obtained by SLM in-situ alloying using a powder mixture of NiTi and Nb powder particles.
